text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Tuesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Zimbabwean farmers, buoyed by a good previous agricultural season and indications of an even better one this year, are preparing to increase the production of virtually all crops to up their earnings and enhance the country's food security.

- The Zimbabwean government is concerned over an emerging trend in which ailing companies are opting for liquidation instead of retrenching their workers, thus denying employees their severance packages.
- The Zimbabwe Congress of Trade Unions has called for the establishment of a consultative body to replace present tripartite consultation between employers, workers and the government.
